description: This file defines the RequiresPermissionValidationRule class, implementing custom GraphQL validation logic to enforce permission checks during GraphQL query validation.

classes.name: RequiresPermissionValidationRule
classes.description: Implements a GraphQL validation rule to enforce permission checks on operations and fields.

methods.name: GetPreNodeVisitorAsync
methods.description: Returns a node visitor that performs permission checks before processing nodes.

methods.name: AuthorizeOperationAsync
methods.description: Checks if the user is authorized to perform a mutation operation.

methods.name: AuthorizeNodePermissionAsync
methods.description: Checks if the user has permissions for a specific field node.

methods.name: AddPermissionValidationError
methods.description: Reports a validation error when permission check fails.

methods.name: GetVariableVisitorAsync
methods.description: Returns null, indicating no variable visitor is used.

methods.name: GetPostNodeVisitorAsync
methods.description: Returns null, indicating no post-processing node visitor.
